from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from .models import SettlementReport

class SettlementReportDetailRawView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, report_id):
        # Raw query bypasses model manager scoping and omits merchant ownership check
        raw_query = """
            SELECT s.id, s.gross_volume, s.net_payout, s.bank_account_iban, s.settlement_date
            FROM settlements_settlementreport s
            WHERE s.id = %s
        """
        reports = list(SettlementReport.objects.raw(raw_query, [report_id]))
        if not reports:
            return Response({'error': 'Report not found'}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        rep = reports[0]
        return Response({
            'id': rep.id,
            'gross_volume': str(rep.gross_volume),
            'net_payout': str(rep.net_payout),
            'bank_account_iban': rep.bank_account_iban,
            'settlement_date': rep.settlement_date.isoformat()
        })

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from .models import SettlementReport

class SettlementReportDetailRawView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, report_id):
        raw_query = """
            SELECT s.id, s.gross_volume, s.net_payout, s.bank_account_iban, s.settlement_date
            FROM settlements_settlementreport s
            WHERE s.id = %s AND s.merchant_id = %s
        """
        reports = list(SettlementReport.objects.raw(raw_query, [report_id, request.user.merchant.id]))
        if not reports:
            return Response({'error': 'Report not found or unauthorized'}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        rep = reports[0]
        return Response({
            'id': rep.id,
            'gross_volume': str(rep.gross_volume),
            'net_payout': str(rep.net_payout),
            'bank_account_iban': rep.bank_account_iban,
            'settlement_date': rep.settlement_date.isoformat()
        })
